Buddies

Fly low. Break ground.

    Controller connected. Left stick steers, A or right trigger fires, B drops bombs, left trigger boosts, D-pad up and down moves the slider, Start pauses, and in any menu the D-pad or left stick moves the highlight, A selects and B goes back. In aircraft the right stick flies and the left stick is throttle or height plus rudder. R2 fires, R1 bombs, hold L2 to zoom in, L3 is thrust or sprint, hold L1 to free look, R3 turns auto lock on or off, the D-pad moves the slider, Y changes the view. On the drone the left stick is throttle and turn and the right stick tilts it.

    Fly together

    Nearby uses Bluetooth and Wi-Fi between phones in the same room, with no internet needed. Online works from anywhere: the host gets a room code and reads it to the others. Everyone must be on the same game version.
